servinfo.title: Electronic Control System Description
servinfo.ptxt: The electronic control system consists of various sensors which detect the state of engine and driving conditions, ECM which controls various devices according to the signals from the sensors and various controlled devices.
Functionally, the electronic control system is divided into the following sub systems:

item.ptxt: When the driver depresses accelerator pedal and brake pedal at the same time, ECM controls engine output by restricting throttle valve opening and prioritizes braking force.
The system may not be activated depending in the following conditions.
Depressing amount of accelerator pedal and brake pedal
The system restricts throttle valve opening mainly. Therefore, ignition timing control and VVT system are affected by this system.

servinfo.ptxt: ECM uses CAN communication system to communicate with other control modules. For more detail of CAN communication, refer to Communication System Description:K12C Model .
